# GMPSignal — Complete 40-Actor Technical API & MCP Reference (`llms-full.txt`)

## Overview
- **Publisher:** GMPSignal (`@gmpsignal`, User ID `IsJvLtZjAD8BlC2Fi`)
- **Apify Store Profile:** `https://apify.com/gmpsignal`
- **Portal URL:** `https://gmpsignal.com`
- **Synchronous REST API Execution Endpoint Pattern:**
  `POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/gmpsignal~<ACTOR_SLUG>/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=<APIFY_API_TOKEN>`
- **Hosted MCP Gateway Endpoint Pattern:**
  `https://mcp.apify.com?actors=gmpsignal/<ACTOR_SLUG>`
- **NPX CLI MCP Command:**
  `npx -y gmpsignal-mcp --suite flagship` (or `npx -y @apify/actors-mcp-server --actors <COMMA_SEPARATED_SLUGS>`)

## Detailed Specification of Flagship Actors

### 1. `gmpsignal/dex-token-scanner-security-auditor`
- **Actor ID:** `m0VEb2jd2miuiwDoc`
- **Pricing:** `$3.50 / 1,000 records` (`PAY_PER_EVENT`)
- **Input JSON Example:**
  ```json
  {
    "chainId": "solana",
    "searchQuery": "SOL",
    "minLiquidityUsd": 10000,
    "maxResults": 15
  }
  ```
- **Key Output Fields:** `pairAddress`, `chainId`, `dexId`, `baseToken`, `priceUsd`, `liquidityUsd`, `volume24hUsd`, `priceChange24h`, `securityAudit` (`isHoneypot`, `buyTax`, `sellTax`, `isMintable`, `safetyScore`, `riskFlags`).

### 2. `gmpsignal/crypto-orderbook-arbitrage-scanner`

  ```json
  {
    "symbols": ["BTCUSDT", "ETHUSDT", "SOLUSDT"],
    "exchanges": ["binance", "bybit", "kraken", "coinbase", "okx", "kucoin"],

  ```
- **Key Output Fields:** `symbol`, `exchange`, `bestBid`, `bestAsk`, `spreadBps`, `slippage10kBps`, `slippage50kBps`, `slippage100kBps`, `bestArbitrageBuyVenue`, `bestArbitrageSellVenue`, `netArbitrageSpreadBps`.
